## Checklist

- [ ] `tools/check.sh` passes locally, and CI is green
- [ ] Visible changes were tried on a real bar
- [ ] Regenerated assets are committed (`.anim`, generated TypeScript, mockups)
- [ ] The app's README is updated, and a `docs/DECISIONS.md` entry covers meaningful choices
- [ ] Version bumped in the app's manifest (only if this is headed for a release)
- [ ] No personal or network details (IPs, subnets, time zones, local paths, names, photos, tokens)
